displayName: CVF web Vitest selection configuration for EAFR-R1D
priorAbsorption: EAFR-R1D uses this configuration to exclude live/provider tests by default and propagate one explicit live opt-in decision to test workers.

findings.summary: Default test selection previously admitted an ambient-key real-provider integration test because no configuration-level live exclusion existed.
findings.nextAction: Retain the config-level selection barrier and explicit activation opt-in; treat it as a local test control rather than a credential-hygiene proof.

negativeSearchTerms: ambient provider key as sole activation signal
nextScanRecommendation: Re-scan if the Vitest include/exclude model, live-test naming convention, or provider-test activation contract changes.
